metadata.description: Google Slides deck generation: template-driven, from-scratch, and Scalar product workflows with a shared Python engine and visual QA

plugins.name: slide-forge
plugins.description: Generate Google Slides decks with Python + the Slides API. Three skills on one shared engine: google-slides-template (generate from a registered master template with interactive intake, spec validation, and thumbnail-based visual QA), google-slides (from-scratch decks via a blank template spec path or a code-first deckkit path with offline layout validation), and scalar-product-slides (Scalar Inc. company/product deck workflow). Includes charts, business-framework figures, pictogram and cloud-vendor icon libraries, AI image generation, and parallel per-page spec authoring for large decks.
